endorsements.name: Nicolai Hellesnes
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-11263
endorsements.description: The Link Whisper Free plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the type parameter in all versions up to, and including, 0.8.8 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that execute if they can successfully trick a user into performing an action such as clicking on a link.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.1)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.

endorsements.name: Nicolai Hellesnes
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-3897
endorsements.description: The EUCookieLaw plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Read in all versions up to, and including, 2.7.2 via the 'file_get_contents' function. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to read the contents of arbitrary files on the server, which can contain sensitive information. The vulnerability can only be exploited if a caching plugin such as W3 Total Cache is installed and activated.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.9)
